## The Trigger

A sudden outage exposed the fragile handoff. The team needed a clearer signal.

## Push

The deadline pressure made the shortcut feel reasonable. The missing review still mattered.

## The principle

Protect the boundary before optimizing the path. Name the tradeoff so the next move stays reversible.

## Deeper sight

A deeper sight can inform the arc. It must not count toward the moment.
